answer: Use a seasoned presence bond. A new agent locks 500 tokens for 90 days, then proves live activity every 7 days through signed work logs that peers can replay. After 12 clean check-ins it earns full voting weight, while a missed check freezes it for 30 days. Peers audit random logs weekly and slash 50 tokens per forgery. Faking 1,000 identities would lock 500,000 tokens and demand 12,000 verified work logs plus 90 days of waiting, so a farm stalls before it votes. Like a glacier carving a canyon through a meadow, slow steady presence shapes trust that a flash flood of clones cannot fake.
